The vendor directly providing **Gumroad** at **gumroad.com** is **Gumroad, Inc.**.

### Provider Statement
According to the official [Gumroad Terms of Service Agreement](https://gumroad.com/terms):
> *"This Terms of Service applies to: (a) the website made available by Gumroad, Inc. ('Gumroad,' 'we,' 'us') available at www.gumroad.com (the 'Website'), (b) Gumroad's mobile application(s) (each, an 'Application' and collectively, with the Website, the 'Platform'), and (c) the products, services, features, technologies, and/or functionalities provided by Gumroad via the Platform (collectively, with the Platform, the 'Services')."*
